description: Adds a lead to a campaign by creating a CampaignMember record, allowing you to track campaign engagement. Both `campaign_id` and `lead_id` must be valid Salesforce IDs of active, existing records — names or emails cannot be substituted, and deleted or inactive records will cause the call to fail. This is a persistent CRM write; confirm the correct lead and campaign before calling.

campaign_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the campaign to add the lead to.
campaign_id.human_parameter_description: The specific Salesforce campaign you want to add this lead to. Paste the campaign’s ID (usually starts with '701') from the campaign page URL.
campaign_id.title: Campaign Id

custom_fields.description: Dictionary of custom field API names and their values for CampaignMember. Custom field names typically end with '__c'.
custom_fields.human_parameter_description: Provide any custom CampaignMember fields to set. Use the API field name (ending in '__c') as the key.
custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

lead_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the lead to add to the campaign.
lead_id.human_parameter_description: The Salesforce lead you want to add to the campaign. Paste the lead’s ID (usually starts with '00Q') from the lead page URL or a prior search.
lead_id.title: Lead Id

status.description: The status of the campaign member. Common values include 'Sent', 'Responded'. The available statuses depend on campaign configuration. Value must exactly match one of the campaign's configured CampaignMember statuses; a mismatch will cause the call to be rejected.
status.human_parameter_description: How you want to mark the lead’s participation in the campaign (for example, Sent or Responded). Pick the value that best matches their current stage; available options depend on the campaign.
status.title: Status

name: add_lead_to_campaign

AddLeadToCampaignResponse.description: Response from adding a lead to a campaign.

errors.description: Array of error objects. Empty array when the operation is successful.
errors.title: Errors

id.title: Id

success.description: Indicates whether the operation completed successfully.
success.title: Success
